content: bwmarrin/snowflake issue #15: package-level mutable globals (nodeShift etc.) trip Go race detector when NewNode and Generate run in parallel (e.g. t.Parallel tests); globals later marked DEPRECATED. Issue #17: two machines both configured NewNode(1) produced identical IDs - static-config node collision in the wild. Issue #9: coarse Windows timer granularity caused repeated identical IDs in tight loops. Issue #44: sequence reset to 0 each ms causes low-QPS IDs to cluster in low sequence values, breaking id-mod-N sharding distribution.
